title: Personal Hardship Assistance, Tropical Cyclone Alfred, March 2025 – Guidelines
summary: Find out about the Personal Hardship Assistance grant available following Tropical Cyclone Alfred in March 2025.
who_can_apply: Be aged 18 or over on 3 March 2025.
Reside at an address situated in the Impacted Region on 3 March 2025.
Be impacted by an Official Power Outage of 48 hours or more or government evacuation orders, caused by the Disaster Event.
Require emergency financial assistance to meet immediate needs for themselves and any Dependents.
Not reside at an address concerning land acquired by the NSW Government under a buy-back scheme.
what_you_need: Applicants applying on behalf of an Eligible Household must follow specific requirements (details not fully provided in the content).

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the Personal Hardship Assistance grant?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over on 3 March 2025, reside in the Impacted Region on 3 March 2025, and be impacted by an Official Power Outage of 48 hours or more or government evacuation orders caused by the Disaster Event.

faqs.q: How much financial assistance is available?
faqs.a: The grant provides $180 per Eligible Individual, and $180 per Dependent, up to a maximum of four Dependents.

faqs.q: When can I apply for the grant?
faqs.a: Applications open at 10am on 12 March 2025 and close at 11:59pm on 8 April 2025.
